meta.title: Song Maker — local-first music studio
meta.description: Generate, edit the score, separate stems, and mix on your GPU. Local desktop with YuE2 — not a cloud Suno clone.

hero.headline: From score to audio, on your machine.
hero.sentence: Local-first desktop studio: YuE2, piano roll, stems, and mix — no account required to create.

promise.title: Your GPU. Editable score. Zero account.
promise.body: Song Maker runs locally with audio.cpp and YuE2 GGUF. You keep control of the score (MIDI, piano roll, ABC), candidates, stems, and mix — before you export.

features.title: What the app actually does
features.body: A tour aligned with capabilities shipped on main — no marketing promises beyond the engines.

yue2.title: YuE2 generation
yue2.body: Style + lyrics, CoT path (`cot`), local audio.cpp queue.

score.title: MIDI · piano roll · ABC
score.body: MIDI import, piano-roll editing, YuE2 ABC validation and export.

candidates.title: Multi-candidate
candidates.body: Sequential generations and an A/B comparator to pick the take.

stems.title: Stem separation
stems.body: HTDemucs and BS-RoFormer to isolate vocals, drums, bass, other.

mix.title: Mix, clips, production
mix.body: Clip timeline plus production overlay (limiter, loudness).

export.title: WAV / FLAC / MP3 export
export.body: Deliver the final mix in the format you need.

lora.title: Optional LoRAs
lora.body: Pack catalog with an explicit CC BY-NC gate — no misleading badge.

remote.title: Host / remote (phase 4)
remote.body: Agent mode and remote GPU worker, with honest guardrails and limits.

examples.title: Listen to excerpts
examples.body: Short synthetic demo beds. These are not real YuE2 renders — they exercise the player and waveforms.

ambient.title: Ambient CoT pad
ambient.meta: Style: ambient pad · cot · seed n/a

gallery.title: The interface, reconstructed
gallery.body: Marketing frames inspired by the React UI and maquettes — product-true, not raw screenshots.

license.title: Licenses — stay honest
license.body: YuE2 / GGUF weights are CC BY-NC 4.0. Song Maker is a personal prototype: no monetization badge, no weight sales, no commercial CC BY-NC claim.
license.note: Optional LoRAs use the same CC BY-NC gate in the app.

gpu.q: Do I need an NVIDIA GPU?
gpu.a: Yes for real CUDA generation. Phase 0 scripts download without a GPU; the CUDA load-test fails clearly without nvidia-smi.

suno.a: No: a local desktop studio with an editable score, stems, and mix. No cloud social feed, no account to create.

os.a: Yes — pinned CUDA archives (Windows cuda12.4, Linux cuda12.8-colab). See the install docs.

commercial.a: GGUF models are CC BY-NC. Do not rely on Song Maker for commercial use.

cta.title: Open the studio.
cta.body: Clone the repo, run phase 0, then generate your first song locally.
